# اِهْرَوْرَقْتِ (ihrawraqti) /ih.raw.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
# اِهْرَوْرَقَتْ (ihrawraqat) /ih
